stories.body: the first indigenous Anti-Submarine Warfare Shallow Water Craft of her class.

stories.title: US sanctions Colombian President Gustavo Petro (24 October)

one_liners: Cochin Shipyard delivers 'Mahe' to the Navy (24 October) — the first indigenous Anti-Submarine Warfare Shallow Water Craft of her class.
US sanctions Colombian President Gustavo Petro (24 October) — escalating the counternarcotics standoff.
